BiblicalUsage: Parvayim is an Oriental region, the source of the gold of Parvaim. Solomon overlays the temple with it in 2 Chronicles 3:6, garnishing the house with precious stones and gold of Parvaim for beauty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gold of a far country was brought to beautify the house of God, and the best of the earth belongs in His service.
